status: Optional design reference; not a runtime registry or production manifest
scope: 72 design recipes in 18 overlapping/composable families: 7 existing v1 presets, 65 proposals. Four audio recipes are bridges, not visual overlays.

families.name: Identitas / shared element
families.connection_contract: Identitas, pusat, ukuran, crop dan radius A → B; sisakan hold setelah landing.
families.local_capability_note: Frame/editable content v1; varian lain membutuhkan layout A/B.

families.name: Graphic match
families.connection_contract: Samakan silhouette atau komposisi pada frame potong; match cut boleh tanpa tween.
families.local_capability_note: Primitive shape lokal; match antar konten tetap perlu aset pasangan.

families.name: Momentum dan lintasan
families.connection_contract: Kecepatan dan arah keluar A diteruskan oleh B; fase deselerasi menghasilkan landing.
families.local_capability_note: GSAP core tersedia; MotionPath plugin perlu diperiksa/dibundel bila dipilih.

families.name: Penutupan / object wipe
families.connection_contract: Potong saat seluruh area konten tertutup; buktikan coverage pada frame hasil decode.
families.local_capability_note: Paper wipe v1 tersedia; bentuk occluder lain membutuhkan produksi baru.

families.name: Kamera pada kanvas 2D
families.connection_contract: Posisi fokus dan skala kamera A/B; gerak selesai pada subjek yang disebut.

families.name: Evolusi bentuk vector
families.connection_contract: Path/subpath dan orientasi dipetakan; endpoint sama dengan bentuk B tanpa pop.
families.local_capability_note: Morph v1 authored; plugin MorphSVG belum otomatis dipasang oleh katalog.

families.name: Handoff makna
families.connection_contract: Kata, angka atau hubungan yang sama muncul dalam fungsi berikutnya; makna harus benar.
families.local_capability_note: Semantic label v1 tersedia; data dan pasangan per adegan tetap perlu authored.

families.name: Tipografi sebagai penghubung
families.connection_contract: Baseline, kata bersama dan panjang glyph; teks terbaca sebelum dan sesudah transisi.
families.local_capability_note: Helper teks ada; glyph mask/split perlu layout deterministik.

families.name: Kertas fisik / replacement
families.connection_contract: Engsel/robekan dan bayangan mengikuti material; pose stepped atau simulasi dipilih eksplisit.
families.local_capability_note: SK.torn/onTwos/piece ada; mesh realistis membutuhkan pre-render baru.

families.name: Garis / draw / erase
families.connection_contract: Tip stroke terakhir menjadi awal elemen B; fill reveal memakai mask terpisah.
families.local_capability_note: SK.drawSeq, SK.highlight, pose tangan tersedia; path baru disiapkan.

families.name: Kontinuitas antarmuka
families.connection_contract: State UI, cursor hotspot dan slot layout konsisten; aksi menghasilkan state yang benar.
families.local_capability_note: Motion-broll ada; bukan otomatisasi browser atau bukti UI asli.

families.name: Kedalaman / multiplane
families.connection_contract: 2–5 layer, depth, focus, overscan dan plate tertutup lubangnya; caption di layer tenang.
families.local_capability_note: SK.layer/camera/dof/dollyZoom ada; sumber layer harus disiapkan.

families.name: Tekstur / luma / distorsi
families.connection_contract: Matte dan displacement adalah kanal berbeda; state B selesai bersih dan terbaca.
families.local_capability_note: Ada tekstur lokal; compositor/shader per resep belum diverifikasi di HyperFrames.

families.name: Pecahan / assemble
families.connection_contract: Setiap fragmen punya asal, tujuan, urutan dan seed tetap; B utuh setelah settle.
families.local_capability_note: Authored fragment sederhana mungkin HTML; simulasi baru membutuhkan bake/pre-render.

families.name: Waktu / editorial loop
families.connection_contract: Pose dan fase A/B sesuai; loop menyamakan frame serta audio boundary.
families.local_capability_note: Replacement helper ada; footage reversal/speed dan loop perlu keputusan editorial.

families.name: Audio sebagai jembatan
families.connection_contract: Envelope, sumber suara dan kata tetap jelas; J/L memerlukan audio scene, bukan hanya whoosh.
families.local_capability_note: 7 SFX v1 ada; bridge per scene membutuhkan source audio dan mix.

families.name: Reveal geometris / rank map
families.connection_contract: Scene A/B dimasking menurut pivot/arah/rank; endpoint hanya B, tanpa crop residu.
families.local_capability_note: clip-path dasar ada; rank-map sampling perlu implementasi dan uji baru.

families.name: Kartu / panel dua sisi
families.connection_contract: Front A/back B, UV/crop, hinge dan urutan panel cocok; final grid utuh.
families.local_capability_note: CSS 3D primitive ada; resep dua sisi dan crop-grid belum diproduksi.

asset_bundles.name: Frame dan viewport
asset_bundles.deliverables: SVG frame; alpha border; editable content slots; crop/focal rectangles; pivots

asset_bundles.name: Bentuk dan match guides
asset_bundles.deliverables: Circle/rect/contour SVG; bounding boxes; composition anchors; endpoint comparison overlay

asset_bundles.name: Lintasan dan momentum
asset_bundles.deliverables: SVG routes; ribbon/carrier; start/end tangents; direction and velocity profile; overscan notes

asset_bundles.name: Occluder dan coverage
asset_bundles.deliverables: Paper/prop/hand/panel silhouettes; cover matte; shadow layer; coverage frame index per aspect

asset_bundles.name: Vector states
asset_bundles.deliverables: Editable state paths; subpath correspondence; pivot; intermediate poses; endpoint labels

asset_bundles.name: Label dan data handoff
asset_bundles.deliverables: Editable chip; word/node/object anchors; number units/domain; real source references

asset_bundles.name: Typography kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Licensed local fonts; editable word spans; glyph outlines when needed; baselines; counter/line masks

asset_bundles.name: Paper mechanics kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Front/back textures; torn edges; crease/hinge pivots; crumple replacement poses; contact shadows

asset_bundles.name: Draw/erase kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Ordered stroke paths; tip coordinates; filled reveal matte; flat hand/eraser poses; local paper backdrop

asset_bundles.name: UI continuity kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Real source captures; separated cards; cursor with hotspot; slots/viewport rectangles; state IDs; demo labels

asset_bundles.name: Depth kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: 2–5 alpha layers; reconstructed clean plate; depth/focus values; overscan; camera endpoints

asset_bundles.name: Material masks kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Grayscale luma sequences; alpha mattes; displacement channels separately; edge policy; clean endpoint frames

asset_bundles.name: Fragment kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Sprites/tiles/cutouts; per-part crop/UV; origin/target transforms; fixed seed; assembly ordering

asset_bundles.name: Audio bridges kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Contact transients; material-specific cues; source ambience; speech pre-roll/tails; mix envelopes and provenance

asset_bundles.name: Geometric/rank reveal kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Iris/radial/strip masks; grayscale reveal order maps; pivot/angle; threshold/softness; open/closed endpoint validation

asset_bundles.name: Two-sided panel kit
asset_bundles.deliverables: Front A/back B textures; UV/crop grids; hinge pivots; backface policy; perspective; flip-order maps and contact shadows
